strings: m_c wanders into the medicine den with a fresh ache in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} chest, just looking for r_c0 for some comfort.
There's no reason for this, nothing has happened recently. Yet m_c wakes with a wail, the weight of grief holding {PRONOUN/m_c/object} down and aching as sharply as if someone had newly passed.
By StarClan, m_c wishes that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} could hold onto the small things, instead of feeling this heavy blanket weight of sadness and longing for things gone.
m_c wanders listlessly around camp, looking for someone or something that is no longer there.
